A '''repulsorlift squad''' was a basic deployment of the [[Imperial Army/Legends|Imperial Army]].

==Organization==
In addition to the combat personnel, [[Repulsorlift/Legends|repulsorlift]] squads were equipped with two [[light transport vehicle]]s. Each vehicle required a four-man crew, including a [[Soldier/Legends|trooper]] [[Technician/Legends|mechanic]], a [[driver]], a [[tech/sensor officer]], and a [[Commander/Legends|commander]] who pulled double duty as the vehicle's [[Gunner/Legends|gunner]]. The [[Sergeant/Legends|sergeant's]] vehicle usually had a [[Dedicated energy receptor/Legends|dedicated energy receptor]] installed where a second tech/sensor officer scanned for enemy communications.<ref name="ISB" />
